item.title: Daily Minute — November 1, 2026
item.description: He will exchange His certainty for all your doubts, if you agree that He is one with you, and that this Oneness is endless, timeless, and within your grasp BECAUSE your hands are HIS. He is within you, yet He walks beside you and before, leading the way that He must go to find Himself complete. His quietness becomes your certainty. And where is doubt when certainty has come? item.title: Lesson 125: “In quiet I receive God’s Word today.”
item.description: “In quiet I receive God’s Word today.” Let this day be a day of stillness and of quiet listening.Your Father wills you hear His Word today. He calls to you from deep within your mind where He abides. Hear Him today. No peace is possible until His Word is heard around the world; until your mind, in quiet listening, accepts the message which the world must hear to usher in the quiet time of peace.
